description: Agent-readiness audit of a website: score 0-100 and grade A-F from 18 checks fetched in parallel. Covers robots.txt rules for GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, Google-Extended, CCBot and Bytespider; llms.txt; sitemap.xml; openapi.json, ai-plugin.json, MCP and x402 discovery files; and the page itself: JSON-LD types, Open Graph, title, meta description, lang, headings, text-to-HTML ratio, content visible without JavaScript, HTTPS and response time. Includes concrete recommendations. Price: $0.01 USDC per call (x402).
